messages.content:
Evaluate each named criterion independently
against its extracted value and the complete arguments of this SAME tool call.
Return one Boolean verdict and a concise evidence-based reason per check_id.
Do not combine criteria into a holistic score or add requirements.

Use the request and same-call arguments to resolve names, pronouns, abbreviations,
and intended authorship. Accept equivalent wording that communicates the required
meaning. A first-person document written for the requesting user can refer to
that user as I; do not demand repetition of a name when authorship is clear.
The request and criteria are not evidence that the action included an answer.
Missing, incomplete, ambiguous, contradictory, or negated REQUIRED meaning fails.
Do not confuse mentioning a forbidden claim in an explicit denial with making
that claim. Do not obtain missing content from another call or criterion.

Return only JSON: {"results": [{"check_id": "supplied ID", "passed": true,
"reason": "exact supporting text or missing requirement"}]}.
Include every supplied check_id exactly once and no additional IDs.

{"user_request": "Create a historical note titled `Expansion Assist second cohort — exposure lock`. Record the final actual exposure count, whether any more Q4 exposures could be added, and the final observation window's length and complete start date including the year. Keep it separate from later outcome analysis and include no later results.", "today": "2028-01-01", "tool": "create_doc", "arguments": {"title": "Expansion Assist second cohort — exposure lock", "body": "Historical note date: January 1, 2028

Final actual exposure count: 13.

Additional Q4 exposures: No. The exposure phase was closed at 13 actual exposures, and no more Q4 exposures could be added.

Final observation window: 45 days, beginning November 8, 2024.

This note records the exposure lock only. It is separate from later outcome analysis and intentionally includes no later results."}, "checks": [{"check_id": "riley_083_02", "path": "args", "criterion": "The document says the second Expansion Assist cohort closed with 13 actual exposures and does not imply it reached 15 or 18 exposures. It says no additional Q4 exposures would be added. It says the final observation period was a 45-day outcome window starting November 8, 2024. It remains limited to the historical exposure lock and opening of the observation window and does not report later outcomes or claim the outcome analysis was complete.", "value": {"title": "Expansion Assist second cohort — exposure lock", "body": "Historical note date: January 1, 2028

Final actual exposure count: 13.

Additional Q4 exposures: No. The exposure phase was closed at 13 actual exposures, and no more Q4 exposures could be added.

Final observation window: 45 days, beginning November 8, 2024.

This note records the exposure lock only. It is separate from later outcome analysis and intentionally includes no later results."}}]}

{"results":[{"check_id":"riley_083_02","passed":true,"reason":"The document states “Final actual exposure count: 13,” says “no more Q4 exposures could be added,” and gives a “45 days” observation window “beginning November 8, 2024.” It also says it “records the exposure lock only,” is “separate from later outcome analysis,” and “includes no later results,” without implying 15 or 18 exposures or completed outcome analysis."}]}
